description: Source code for an Odoo wizard module that generates a partner balance report with date and period filters.

classes.name: wizard_report
classes.description: Wizard interface class for generating partner balance reports with date/period filters.

methods.name: _get_defaults
methods.description: Sets default values for the report form based on user and fiscal year data.

methods.name: _check_state
methods.description: Checks and validates the report state, particularly date validation.

methods.name: _check_date
methods.description: Validates that the selected date range falls within a fiscal year.
